entries.title: A risk dot's note sets its rating apart from the reason
entries.body: Resting on a dot of a merge card's risk chart opens a note whose first line, the risk and its rating, now stands out brighter, with a gap before the crewmate's reason under it.

picture.alt: A risk dot's note with Undo and its rating on a bright first line, and the crewmate's reason in softer text a gap below
